caption: The drawing features two elongated, metal objects placed parallel to each other on a plain, off-white background. Both objects are colored with shades of brown, gray, and hints of red, giving them a rusted, worn appearance. Each object has a flat, rectangular head at one end, with the body tapering gradually to a narrower, flat tip at the opposite end. The heads are wider than the bodies, and the bodies exhibit irregular, slightly bent shapes. There are no other objects or decorations present in the drawing, except for the artist's signature, "Grant Vandergool," written in cursive at the lower right corner.
title: Handwrought Nails
